atomchat.tutorial.prompt.title: Getting started
atomchat.tutorial.prompt.body: Explore chat, players and personalization with guided notes. Skip any step or exit at any time. Replay from About.
atomchat.tutorial.replay.desc: Replay the tutorial from the beginning
atomchat.tutorial.demo: Tutorial demo · never saved or sent
atomchat.tutorial.type_hint: Type a short message, then press Send
atomchat.tutorial.demo_message: Sample message · click or right-click to quote
atomchat.tutorial.demo_block: Demo player · select to try blocking
atomchat.tutorial.demo_blocked: Blocking demonstrated · your block list is unchanged
atomchat.tutorial.demo_sticker: Stickers: sample sticker · select to change category
atomchat.tutorial.demo_image_open: Image preview demo · no file is uploaded
atomchat.tutorial.demo_phrase: Quick phrase: Hello! · select to try
atomchat.tutorial.demo_phrase_selected: Selected: Hello! · your real draft is unchanged
atomchat.tutorial.demo_notification: Mention · demo notification; normally opens its conversation
atomchat.tutorial.navigation.title: Meet the navigation bar
atomchat.tutorial.navigation.body: The bottom bar switches between conversations, profile and settings. Select a tab to try it. Navigation remains interactive during transitions.
atomchat.tutorial.conversations.title: Conversations and world chat
atomchat.tutorial.conversations.body: Open public chat for the world channel, or select a player for a private conversation. The sample card shown here is demonstration content.
atomchat.tutorial.compose.title: Compose and send
atomchat.tutorial.compose.body: Type a message and press Send. This isolated demo never contacts a server or replaces your draft. Real chat supports multiple lines and retaining unsent text.
atomchat.tutorial.message_actions.title: Message actions and quotes
atomchat.tutorial.message_actions.body: Click or right-click the sample message to try quoting. Real message menus also offer actions such as copying. A quote appears above the composer and can be cancelled without losing your draft.
atomchat.tutorial.search_filter.title: Search and filter
atomchat.tutorial.search_filter.body: Search chat history or use the world-channel header control to filter messages. Searching changes the view without deleting chat content. Close search to return.
atomchat.tutorial.players_block.title: Players and blocking
atomchat.tutorial.players_block.body: Player cards open private chats or profiles; their menus can block players. Select the sample to try blocking without changing your real list. Manage blocked players and visibility in Privacy.
atomchat.tutorial.profile.title: Your profile
atomchat.tutorial.profile.body: View or edit your avatar, banner and signature, and choose an avatar style. This step only explains the layout; it does not pick files or change personal assets.
atomchat.tutorial.expressions.title: Emoji, kaomoji and stickers
atomchat.tutorial.expressions.body: Select the emoji button, then explore the sample categories above. Real selections insert emoji, kaomoji or custom stickers into chat. This step never sends or changes your real draft.
atomchat.tutorial.images.title: Images and previews
atomchat.tutorial.images.body: Select the image button and sample to learn about image messages and previews. In real chat, select or paste an image and open image messages to preview them. This demo never picks or uploads files.
atomchat.tutorial.quick_phrases.title: Quick phrases
atomchat.tutorial.quick_phrases.body: Select the quick-phrase button, then the sample phrase. Real quick phrases can be edited and reused to reduce typing. Demo selections leave your phrases and draft unchanged.
atomchat.tutorial.settings_home.title: Settings overview
atomchat.tutorial.settings_home.body: Settings are grouped into Appearance, Chat, Privacy and About. The next steps explain each group without requiring every slider to be adjusted.
atomchat.tutorial.chat_settings.title: Chat settings groups
atomchat.tutorial.chat_settings.body: Use the tabs to browse Messages, History, Notifications and Advanced. These cover sending behavior, presentation, history retention, sounds and effects. This step permits tab browsing without changing switches.
atomchat.tutorial.appearance.title: Make it yours
atomchat.tutorial.appearance.body: Choose a theme, independent wallpaper, colors, opacity, corner radius, motion or panel display settings. Your changes are saved normally. Skip this step to keep your current look.
atomchat.tutorial.privacy.title: Privacy and blocked players
atomchat.tutorial.privacy.body: Privacy manages blocked players, whether their messages are hidden, and server resource packs. This step explains these controls without changing your list or settings.
atomchat.tutorial.notifications.title: Notifications and sounds
atomchat.tutorial.notifications.body: The notification group controls mention and private-chat banners, sounds, and HUD placement and scale. The sample banner is never queued, sounds nothing and leaves your HUD unchanged.
atomchat.tutorial.about.title: About and replay
atomchat.tutorial.about.body: About contains the tutorial replay row, authors, version, license, third-party information, cache cleanup and debugging. Finish to return to your original page. Every replay begins at step one.
atomchat.tutorial.save_failed: Could not save the tutorial choice. This session will not ask again; reopening the panel retries saving.
